## Input contract

The count matrix must contain integer counts, one gene per row, and one sample per column. The metadata must contain a unique `sample_id` column matching count-matrix columns.

~~~{r}
library(targets)
obj <- tar_read(input_check)
dim(obj$counts)
obj$metadata
~~~

## Library size

~~~{r}
library(edgeR)
barplot(colSums(obj$counts), las = 2, ylab = "Raw library size")
~~~

For a real project, add normalized library-size plots, sample correlations, PCA/MDS, and an explicit batch review before fitting models.
